notes.title: A New Era Begins – Major Update Now Live!
notes.content:
[b][h1]A New Era Begins in The First Settlement VR![/h1][/b]

A huge update has just arrived—bringing major improvements to how you build, manage, and experience your medieval settlement. This marks the next step in making your VR world feel truly alive.

[b]What’s New in This Update:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Bird’s-Eye View: [/b]Take control with a brand-new top-down perspective to place buildings more easily and plan your village like never before.
[*] [b]Tutorial: [/b]New to the game? No worries! A guided tutorial now helps you get started step by step.
[*] [b]Enhanced Environment:[/b] Trees, fields, and natural surroundings have been upgraded for a richer, more immersive world.
[*] [b]Improved Building Placement:[/b] Smoother and more intuitive placement system for constructing your settlement.
[*] [b]More Worker Variety: [/b]Your workers now have more visual diversity to bring your town to life.
[*] Increased Animations: Citizens and workers are now more active—bringing movement and energy to every corner of your town.
[*] [b]New Public Building – Market:[/b] Introduce a central hub for trade and daily life in your settlement.
[*] [b]Citizen Happiness Reactions:[/b] Citizens now react to their happiness—dancing with joy or showing discontent depending on how well their needs are met.
[*] [b]Public Building Demand: [/b]Your people now expect certain public buildings—making city planning even more important.
[*] [b]Growing Fields:[/b] See your plantations and farms come to life with visible plant growth over time.
[*] Minor bug fixes and stability improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: New Update: Ancient Forest Level & Wildlife Enhancements!
notes.content:
New Features:

[list]
[*] New Level: Now you can build your settlement in the mysterious shadows of an ancient forest.
[*] Dynamic Wildlife: If your citizens' happiness exceeds 6, playful cats will appear near your starting area. Otherwise, watch out for rats and crows!
[*] Improved Animal Behavior: Chickens and sheep models updated—animals are now more active and lively.
[/list]
Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where public buildings and citizens' houses could only be built within your first town hall's radius. Now you can expand freely using additional town halls.
[*] Minor bug fixes and stability improvements.
[/list]
Enjoy the update, and thanks for your support!

notes.title: Update Released: German Localization & Improved Streets
notes.content: The First Settlement VR is now available in German! Also enjoy smoother city-building—streets can now be built without obstruction from other objects.
